title.narrative: Climate-resilient WASH and Livelihoods Package for Resilient Somali Landscapes

description.narrative: Directly, approximately 121,744 individuals (50% female and 10% persons with disabilities (PWDs)) will be targeted, including vulnerable agrarians and pastoralists, internally displaced persons (IDPs), and institutional actors (community committees in all project locations and local government officials in Somaliland). Indirectly, 146,250 individuals in vulnerable agrarian and pastoral communities will benefit from the proposed measures.

Objective of the project: Livelihoods and resilience of vulnerable agrarian and agropastoralist people are strengthened through protection and restoration of key natural resources and WASH services in agrarian, pastoral, and agropastoral areas through community-led actions and improved market access for key rural value chains.Outcome 1:The livelihoods of 27,234 people are strengthened through restoration and stabilization of agrarian, pastoral, and agropastoral landscapes.Outcome 2: 121,744 people have access to improved WASH services established or strengthened through women’s active participation.Outcome 3: Technical packages of sustainable livelihoods strategies in landscape-restorative and climate resilient value chains are developed and scaled through farmer field schools and women’s groups.

The project aims to enhance the livelihoods and resilience of 121,744 vulnerable agrarian and pastoralist people through protection and restoration of key natural resources and WASH services in agrarian, pastoral, and agropastoral areas through community-led actions and improved market access for key rural value chains. The project will partly be implemented by local partner NGOs in South Central Somalia (Hiraan and Galgaduud) and Somaliland (Togdheer and Sool) in close collaboration with relevant local and regional authorities’ other key stakeholders. The project also supports international coordination and planning at the 'humanitarian-development nexus' through support to Somalia's Resilience Working Group - an initiative of the Somali NGO Consortium.
